text: Reads an invoice JSON file as input
Input has items, each with description, quantity, unit price
Input may have optional discount (invoice valid without it)
Validates input and reports all errors at once (not just the first)
Invalid input yields non-zero exit / error reporting, no invoice output
Computes line totals (quantity x unit price)
Correct money rounding (Decimal, half-up to cents, no float artifacts)
Malformed JSON / missing file handled gracefully (no traceback)
